title: Bounded computational reachability
statement: For natural numbers $C,e,B$, a Boolean mode, a function $f$ from Boolean lists to Boolean lists, and an input $h$ that is a Boolean list, define the bounded reachability predicate to mean reachability from $h$ for the machine determined by $C,e,$ and the mode, using the oracle determined by $f$, subject to the good-configuration condition determined by $C,e,$ the mode, $h$, and $B$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps Boolean lists to Boolean lists
caveat: The supplied snippet does not include the meanings of the machine, oracle, reachability, or good-configuration constructions, so their details cannot be stated more explicitly.
